howto: Press Play: the dino jogs on the spot until your first jump.
Tap anywhere to jump; tap again in the air for a double jump.
Hold the DUCK button (or swipe down) to slip under low pterodactyls.
Run as far as you can: metres are your score, bones are coins for new dinos.
tips: High pterodactyls fly over your head: just keep running underneath.
An amber gem is a shield that takes one hit; the magnet pulls bones to you.
Clear an obstacle by a whisker for a +8 close bonus.
Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum medals are at 200, 500, 900 and 1,500 m; run 1,000 m for the Golden dino and 1,500 m for the Crystal dino.
The sky goes from golden hour to dusk to night every 250 m.

controls.keyboard: Space, Up or W to jump, Down or S to duck. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to jump, tap again for a double jump, hold the DUCK button or swipe down to duck

difficulty: An adaptive curve: the desert speeds up the further you run, and obstacles come closer together, but never faster than you can react.

cheats.effect: Iron hide: cacti and birds bounce off you
Bone magnet stays on for the whole run
Slow motion: the desert runs at 60% speed

features.one-tap-start: Play, then one tap jumps and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again or Space on the results card goes straight back to the start line
features.best-score-badge: BEST under the distance, top right of the game
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger on the first run
features.results: Result card with metres, medal, best, top-5 runs, bones earned, today's goals and the next dino to unlock
features.progression: Nine dinos (seven bought with bones, two unlocked by distance), three daily goals plus a star challenge, week stamps with a weekly gift, four medals
features.daily-goals: Three goals and one star challenge a day
